name: ballerinax/oracledb
description: This module provides the functionality required to access and manipulate data stored in an Oracle database. It enables seamless integration with OracleDB, supporting various data types and advanced database features.

typeDefs.name: SecureSocket
typeDefs.description: SSL configurations to be used when connecting to the Oracle database server.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Keystore configuration of the client certificates

fields.name: cert
fields.description: Truststore configuration of the trust certificates

typeDefs.name: Options
typeDefs.description: Provides an additional set of configurations related to the Oracle database connection.

fields.name: ssl
fields.description: SSL configurations to be used

fields.name: loginTimeout
fields.description: Timeout (in seconds) to be used when connecting to the Oracle server and authentication (0 means no timeout)

fields.name: autoCommit
fields.description: If true, commits automatically when the statement is complete

fields.name: connectTimeout
fields.description: Timeout (in seconds) to be used when connecting to the Oracle server

fields.name: socketTimeout
fields.description:
Socket timeout (in seconds) to be used during the read/write operations with the Oracle database server
(0 means no socket timeout)

fields.name: useXADatasource
fields.description: If true, uses XADatasource for transactions

typeDefs.name: AdapterMode
typeDefs.description: Oracle CDC adapter modes for capturing changes from the Oracle database transaction logs. LogMiner is the only adapter supported by this module.

typeDefs.name: LogMiningStrategy
typeDefs.description: LogMiner mining strategy used when reading redo / archive logs and extracting change events.

typeDefs.name: LogMiningQueryFilterMode
typeDefs.description: How table-include filters are applied to the LogMiner query.

typeDefs.name: IntervalHandlingMode
typeDefs.description: How Oracle INTERVAL data types are represented in change events.

typeDefs.name: DriverKeyStore
typeDefs.description: Client keystore for mTLS authentication against Oracle (driver pass-through).

fields.name: path
fields.description: Filesystem path to the keystore file

fields.name: password
fields.description: Keystore password

fields.name: storeType
fields.description: Keystore format (JKS, PKCS12); defaults to JKS

typeDefs.name: DriverTrustStore
typeDefs.description: Server-certificate truststore for TLS verification (driver pass-through).

fields.name: path
fields.description: Filesystem path to the truststore file

fields.name: password
fields.description: Truststore password

fields.name: storeType
fields.description: Truststore format (JKS, PKCS12); defaults to JKS

typeDefs.name: DriverSslConfiguration
typeDefs.description: JDBC driver SSL/TLS keystore and truststore configuration for mTLS connections to Oracle.

fields.name: keyStore
fields.description: Client keystore (`driver.javax.net.ssl.keyStore*`)

fields.name: trustStore
fields.description: Server certificate truststore (`driver.javax.net.ssl.trustStore*`)

typeDefs.name: DriverConfiguration
typeDefs.description:
Oracle JDBC driver pass-through configuration.
All values are emitted with the `driver.` prefix as Debezium pass-through properties.

fields.name: mtls
fields.description:
mTLS client authentication for Oracle — supply either a Java keystore/truststore
(`DriverSslConfiguration`, mapped to `driver.javax.net.ssl.*`) or an Oracle Wallet
location string (mapped to `driver.oracle.net.wallet_location`). These are two
alternative methods per Debezium's docs, not combinable.

fields.name: timezoneAsRegion
fields.description:
Whether the JDBC driver should resolve timezone as a region
(`driver.oracle.jdbc.timezoneAsRegion`). Set to `false` to work around
ORA-01882 "timezone region not found".

typeDefs.name: LogMinerMemoryBufferConfiguration
typeDefs.description: In-memory LogMiner transaction buffer tunables.

fields.name: trackRsId
fields.description:
Track the row-id (RS_ID) of each event in the transaction buffer. 
Turning this off trims memory and the data pulled per LogMiner query, at the cost of losing that identifier

fields.name: transactionEventsThreshold
fields.description:
Max events per transaction before abandoning the transaction. 
The default is not having a transaction event threshold

typeDefs.name: LogMinerBatchConfiguration
typeDefs.description:
SCN-based LogMiner mining batch sizing. 
SCN is a monotonically increasing integer that Oracle stamps onto every committed change in the database.
Debezium uses the SCN as its streaming offset/position.

fields.name: minSize
fields.description: Minimum SCN window size

fields.name: maxSize
fields.description: Maximum SCN window size

fields.name: incrementSize
fields.description: Amount to grow/shrink the window when adapting

fields.name: defaultSize
fields.description: Initial / fallback SCN window size

typeDefs.name: LogMinerSleepConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Sleep timing between LogMiner mining iterations (all values in seconds).

fields.name: minTime
fields.description: Minimum sleep duration

fields.name: maxTime
fields.description: Maximum sleep duration

fields.name: defaultTime
fields.description: Initial / fallback sleep duration

fields.name: incrementTime
fields.description: Amount to grow/shrink sleep when adapting

typeDefs.name: LogMinerArchiveLogConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Archive-log mining configuration for LogMiner.

fields.name: logHours
fields.description:
Number of hours of archive logs to scan for the start SCN.
If not set, the connector mines all archive logs

fields.name: destinationName
fields.description:
Configured Oracle archive destination(s) to use when mining archive logs.
When not set, the first valid, local configured destination is automatically selected

fields.name: logOnlyMode
fields.description:
Mine only archive logs, and ignore the redo-logs.
This allows reliable log mining at the cost of potentially increased latency

fields.name: logOnlyScnPollInterval
fields.description:
Poll interval in seconds when waiting for a new SCN.
Applicable only if `logOnlyMode` is `true`

typeDefs.name: LogMinerConfiguration
typeDefs.description:
LogMiner adapter tunables. Applies to both `LOGMINER` and `LOGMINER_UNBUFFERED` adapter modes.
When `adapterMode == LOGMINER_UNBUFFERED`, all `buffer.*` fields are accepted but ignored by the
database-side buffer.

fields.name: strategy
fields.description: Mining strategy (`online_catalog` / `redo_log_catalog` / `hybrid`)

fields.name: queryFilterMode
fields.description: How table-include filters are applied to the mining query

fields.name: readOnlyHostname
fields.description: Hostname of a read-only standby to direct LogMiner queries at

fields.name: flushTableName
fields.description: Name of the internal flush table; useful for RAC deployments

fields.name: buffer
fields.description: In-memory transaction buffer tunables

fields.name: sessionMaxDuration
fields.description: Max time before closing and reopening the LogMiner session, in seconds; no limit if not set

fields.name: restartConnection
fields.description: Restart the JDBC connection when a mining session is rotated

fields.name: batch
fields.description: SCN-based batch sizing

fields.name: sleep
fields.description: Sleep timing between mining iterations

fields.name: archive
fields.description: Archive-log mining configuration

fields.name: transactionRetentionTime
fields.description:
Time to retain transactions in the buffer before forced commit/rollback in seconds.
If not set, transactions are retained until a commit or rollback is detected

fields.name: maxWindowTime
fields.description:
Max mining window duration in seconds before forced advance of the offset. 
If not set, the offset sits at the lower bound of the oldest open transaction start SCN 
until it is committed or rolled back.

fields.name: includedUsernames
fields.description: Usernames whose changes to capture (mutually exclusive with `excludedUsernames`)

fields.name: excludedUsernames
fields.description: Usernames whose changes to skip (mutually exclusive with `includedUsernames`)

fields.name: includedClientIds
fields.description: JDBC client IDs whose changes to capture (mutually exclusive with `excludedClientIds`)

fields.name: excludedClientIds
fields.description: JDBC client IDs whose changes to skip (mutually exclusive with `includedClientIds`)

fields.name: scnGapDetectionMinSize
fields.description: Minimum SCN delta to consider for gap detection

fields.name: scnGapDetectionMaxInterval
fields.description: Max time window in seconds for the SCN gap detection heuristic

typeDefs.name: ConfigurationBasedSnapshot
typeDefs.description: Fine-grained switches used when `snapshotMode == CONFIGURATION_BASED`.

fields.name: includeData
fields.description: Include row data in the snapshot

fields.name: includeSchema
fields.description: Include schema (DDL) in the snapshot

fields.name: startStream
fields.description: Start streaming after the snapshot completes

fields.name: snapshotOnSchemaError
fields.description: Re-snapshot on schema error

fields.name: snapshotOnDataError
fields.description: Re-snapshot on data error

typeDefs.name: OracleExtendedSnapshotConfiguration
typeDefs.description:
Oracle-specific extended snapshot configuration.
Extends the relational base with configuration-based snapshot sub-flags.

fields.name: configurationBased
fields.description: Sub-flags active only when `snapshotMode == CONFIGURATION_BASED`

typeDefs.name: OracleDataTypeConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Oracle-specific data type handling.

fields.name: intervalHandlingMode
fields.description: How Oracle `INTERVAL` types are represented (numeric vs ISO-8601 string)

typeDefs.name: OracleDatabaseConnection
typeDefs.description: Represents the configuration for the Oracle CDC database connection.

fields.name: connectorClass
fields.description: Fully-qualified Debezium connector class name (hardcoded)

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Oracle server hostname; ignored when `url` is set

fields.name: port
fields.description: Oracle listener port; ignored when `url` is set

fields.name: databaseName
fields.description: Root container (CDB) or non-CDB database name. Required regardless of `url`

fields.name: url
fields.description: Raw JDBC URL for TNS / RAC / TCPS connections. Overrides `hostname` and `port` only

fields.name: pdbName
fields.description: Pluggable database name (multi-tenant installations only)

fields.name: adapterMode
fields.description: LogMiner mode: connector-side (`LOGMINER`) or database-side (`LOGMINER_UNBUFFERED`)

fields.name: racNodes
fields.description: RAC node list (`host:port` or `host:port/SID`); required for RAC even when `url` is set

fields.name: includedSchemas
fields.description: Regex patterns for schemas to capture (mutually exclusive with `excludedSchemas`)

fields.name: excludedSchemas
fields.description: Regex patterns for schemas to exclude (mutually exclusive with `includedSchemas`)

fields.name: includedTables
fields.description: Regex patterns for tables to capture (mutually exclusive with `excludedTables`)

fields.name: excludedTables
fields.description: Regex patterns for tables to exclude (mutually exclusive with `includedTables`)

fields.name: includedColumns
fields.description: Regex patterns for columns to capture (mutually exclusive with `excludedColumns`)

fields.name: excludedColumns
fields.description: Regex patterns for columns to exclude (mutually exclusive with `includedColumns`)

fields.name: logMinerConfig
fields.description: LogMiner adapter tunables (apply to both `LOGMINER` and `LOGMINER_UNBUFFERED`)

fields.name: driverConfig
fields.description: Oracle JDBC driver pass-through (mTLS, Oracle Wallet, timezone-as-region)

typeDefs.name: OracleOptions
typeDefs.description: Oracle-specific CDC options for snapshot, LOB capture, streaming, and data type handling.

fields.name: extendedSnapshot
fields.description: Snapshot config with Oracle-specific configuration-based sub-flags

fields.name: dataTypeConfig
fields.description: Data type handling including Oracle `INTERVAL` handling

fields.name: heartbeatConfig
fields.description: Heartbeat configuration for keeping the connection alive

fields.name: streamingDelay
fields.description: Delay between snapshot completion and streaming start, in seconds

fields.name: queryFetchSize
fields.description: JDBC fetch size for streaming queries

fields.name: lobEnabled
fields.description: Enable CLOB / NCLOB / BLOB / XML capture (incompatible with `HYBRID` mining strategy)

fields.name: unavailableValuePlaceholder
fields.description: Placeholder string emitted for unchanged LOB columns

fields.name: snapshotDatabaseErrorsMaxRetries
fields.description: Per-table retry count for snapshot-time DB errors (e.g., ORA-01466)

typeDefs.name: OracleListenerConfiguration
typeDefs.description: Oracle CDC listener configuration including database connection, storage, and CDC options.

fields.name: database
fields.description: Oracle database connection, LogMiner, driver, and capture settings

fields.name: options
fields.description: Oracle-specific CDC options including snapshot, LOB, streaming, and data type handling

typeDefs.name: Sign

typeDefs.name: IntervalDayToSecond

fields.name: days

fields.name: minutes

fields.name: seconds

typeDefs.name: ObjectType
typeDefs.description: Represents the Oracle UDT type, which is an abstraction of the real-world entities such as purchase orders that application programs deal with.

fields.name: typename

fields.name: attributes

typeDefs.name: Varray
typeDefs.description: Represents an ordered set of data elements with a variable size but with a maximum size defined. All elements of a given array are# of the same data type with null value support.

fields.name: name

typeDefs.description: The iterator for the stream returned from the `query` function to be used to override the default behaviour of `sql:ResultIterator`.

functions.description: The iterator for the stream returned from the `query` function to be used to override the default behaviour of `sql:ResultIterator`.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initializes the OracleDB Client. The client must be kept open throughout the application lifetime.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Hostname of the Oracle database server

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Name of a user of the Oracle database server

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password of the Oracle database server for the provided username

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: System identifier or the service name of the database

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port number of the Oracle database server

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Oracle database connection properties

parameters.name: connectionPool
parameters.description:
The `sql:ConnectionPool` object to be used within the client. If there is no
`connectionPool` provided, the global connection pool will be used

return.description: An `sql:Error` if the client creation fails

functions.name: query
functions.description:
Executes the query, which may return multiple results.
When processing the stream, make sure to consume all fetched data or close the stream.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query such as `` `SELECT * from Album WHERE name=${albumName}` ``

parameters.name: rowType
parameters.description: The `typedesc` of the record to which the result needs to be returned

return.description: Stream of records in the `rowType` type

functions.name: queryRow
functions.description:
Executes the query, which is expected to return at most one row of the result.
If the query does not return any results, an `sql:NoRowsError` is returned.

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query such as `` `SELECT * from Album WHERE name=${albumName}` ``

parameters.name: returnType
parameters.description:
The `typedesc` of the record to which the result needs to be returned.
It can be a basic type if the query result contains only one column

return.description: Result in the `returnType` type or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: execute
functions.description: Executes the SQL query. Only the metadata of the execution is returned (not the results from the query).

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query such as `` `DELETE FROM Album WHERE artist=${artistName}` ``

return.description: Metadata of the query execution as an `sql:ExecutionResult` or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: batchExecute
functions.description:
Executes the SQL query with multiple sets of parameters in a batch. Only the metadata of the execution is returned (not results from the query).
If one of the commands in the batch fails, the `sql:BatchExecuteError` will be returned immediately.

parameters.name: sqlQueries
parameters.description: The SQL query with multiple sets of parameters

return.description: Metadata of the query execution as an `sql:ExecutionResult[]` or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: call

parameters.name: sqlQuery
parameters.description: The SQL query such as `` `{call sp_GetAlbums()}` `` or `` `{${retVal} = call myFunc(${param})}` ``

parameters.name: rowTypes
parameters.description: `typedesc` array of the records to which the results need to be returned

return.description: Summary of the execution and results are returned in an `sql:ProcedureCallResult`, or an `sql:Error`

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the JDBC client and shuts down the connection pool. The client must be closed only at the end of the
application lifetime (or closed for graceful stops in a service).
